scope: Read-only replacement capture card investigation; no target input, configuration changes, screen inspection, screenshots or OCR retained.

checks.action: Confirm macOS camera inventory, autopaws-kvm --list-devices and FFmpeg AVFoundation discovery all enumerate the card
checks.observation: All enumerate the card. FFmpeg 9.1 appends whitespace-separated [uid:...] metadata to video and audio names.

checks.action: Open the automatically selected card using the unpatched Go AVFoundation backend
checks.observation: avfoundation: device missing or ambiguous: FFmpeg cannot select literal name containing the UID suffix.

checks.action: Open USB Video:none directly with FFmpeg and discard one frame using the null output
checks.observation: The card accepts 1920x1080 at the requested 30 fps. FFmpeg negotiates uyvy422.

checks.action: Discover, automatically select and open the card using the patched Go AVFoundation backend; read three frames, printing metadata only, then close
checks.observation: Selected avfoundation:USB Video; all three frames are 1920x1080 MJPEG. Frame contents were neither inspected nor retained.

checks.action: Run AVFoundation regression tests against old listings and UID-annotated video/audio listings
checks.observation: The new regression test fails before the parser fix and passes after it.

limits: No audio stream or browser playback test.
The installed autopaws binary was not replaced.
